title: sarcolobus globosus subsp. peregrinus
intro: Sarcolobus globosus subsp. peregrinus, commonly known as Pega, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Sarcolobus globosus subsp. peregrinus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
